overview: Half-height dirt, grass, farmland, path and the rest, with the crops, plants, spreading, snow and worldgen that full blocks get.

2.0.1: Sugar cane and bamboo on a slab grow as the slab kind the whole way up.
The stalk sits at the slab's height instead of stepping back to full blocks.
Natural terrain slabs are an op toggle in the mods menu.
Growth particles read the crop's own age, so beetroots stop finishing early.
2.0.0: The whole family: dirt, coarse dirt, farmland, grass path, grass, mud, mycelium, podzol, rooted.
Crafted three in a row for six slabs, or halved in place with a shovel.
Each with the advancement that unlocks it.
Terrain slabs smooth elevation changes in worldgen without terracing villages.
Trampled farmland lifts you out and breaks to a dirt slab.
A tree restores the ground it grew from, and anything on terrain keeps the full block under it.
